question: What physical rejuvenation results from the wheel-based visualization?
premises: The practitioner becomes free from wrinkles and grey hair.
The practitioner becomes devoid of all diseases.
inference: This visualization yields freedom from signs of aging and all diseases.
uncertainties: The accusative ending of sarvavyādhivivarjitam may agree with an implied object rather than the nominative subject.
plain_english: One becomes freed from wrinkles and grey hair, and devoid of all diseases.
